description: A writ of execution ordering a sheriff to sell real property under a foreclosure judgment

court.description: The court issuing the writ, e.g. 'Circuit Court of the State of Oregon for the County of Multnomah'

defendants.description: Each defendant named in the caption, as printed

directed_to.description: The officer the writ is addressed to, after 'TO:'

judgment_type.description: The judgment being enforced, e.g. 'General Judgment of Foreclosure and Sale'

judgment_date.description: The date the judgment was entered, as YYYY-MM-DD

deed_of_trust_date.description: The date of the deed of trust, as YYYY-MM-DD

legal_description.description: The legal description of the property, as printed

property_address.description: The address the property is commonly known as, as one line

amount_to_satisfy.description: The sum to be satisfied, in USD

amount_as_of.description: The date that sum is stated as of, as YYYY-MM-DD

post_judgment_interest_rate_percent.description: The post-judgment interest rate, as a percent number (9.0 for 9.00%)

return_within_days.description: The number of days within which the writ must be returned

creditor_attorney_firm.description: The law firm acting for the judgment creditor

issued_date.description: The date written beside the court's signature, as YYYY-MM-DD

has_court_seal.description: True if the writ carries the court's seal

is_signed.description: True if the writ is signed for the court
